description: This file defines a C# class TransactionRootGrain implementing the ITransactionRootGrain interface within the Orleans framework. It includes attributes for reentrancy and stateless worker configuration, and contains a Run method that executes grains concurrently.

classes.name: TransactionRootGrain
classes.description: A grain class for managing transaction root logic, supporting reentrant and stateless execution, and running multiple transaction grains concurrently.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a list of grains concurrently by invoking their Run method.
